newsitem.title: USA: Applied Extrusion has manufacturing problem.
newsitem.headline: Applied Extrusion has manufacturing problem.

text.p: Applied Extrusion Technologies Inc said Wednesday that it is experiencing manufacturing problems at its primary production facility in Terre Haute, Indiana.

The company said that as a result, manufacturing and maintenance costs will be significantly higher than planned. The current manufacturing difficulties are expected to last for at least several weeks.

The company said it expects to achieve its revenue goal for the second quarter, ended March 31, and customer deliveries will not be affected due in part to the fact that Applied Extrusion produced sufficient inventories during the first fiscal quarter.
Demand for oriented polypropylene films remains strong, said the company, and it expects to achieve its revenue goals for both the third and fourth fiscal quarters.
Applied Extrusion Technologies makes and sells highly specialized plastic films used primarily in consumer product labeling, flexible packaging and health care applications.
